sharedRules.name: Construct
sharedRules.description: models drop Scrap Markers when they are killed

sharedRules.name: Living
sharedRules.description: The model's controller places a Corpse Marker in base contact with the model before it is removed.

sharedRules.name: Slow
sharedRules.description: A model with the Slow Condition generates 1 less general AP when it Activates.

sharedRules.name: Undead
sharedRules.description: The model's controller places a Corpse Marker in base contact with the model before it is removed.

sharedRules.name: Unhirable
sharedRules.description: This model may not be hired, it may only be summoned.

rules.name: Decaying Aura
rules.description:
Enemy models within (pulse)4 may not
be healed.

rules.name: Bane
rules.description:
Enemy models may not use Soulstones to
prevent damage caused by this model's Attack
Actions or Abilities.
